clause.text: No citizen shall be discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion, language, caste, sex, political opinion, place of birth or any one of such grounds.

case_context.legal_issue: Whether the petitioner was discriminated against on prohibited grounds in violation of Article 12(2) during his arrest and detention.
case_context.petitioner_claim: The petitioner implied discrimination as a Tamil and alleged unlawful arrest and detention related to suspicion of LTTE membership.
case_context.respondent_argument: Respondents did not explicitly address discrimination claims under Article 12(2).
key_facts: Petitioner was alleged to be a member of the LTTE, a Tamil militant group.
No material was produced to show reasonable grounds for arrest at the time.
Petitioner was detained without valid detention orders and assaulted.

reasoning.interpretation_summary: The court did not explicitly find or discuss discrimination under Article 12(2) in its reasoning or holding.
reasoning.application_to_facts: The case focused on unlawful arrest and detention procedures rather than direct discrimination claims.

link_explanation.why_this_clause_matters: Article 12(2) was not materially engaged or relied upon in the court’s reasoning or decision.

evidence.evidence_excerpt: No material was produced before this Court to show that at the time of the arrest of the petitioner, the arresting officers had such information prior to the decision to arrest the petitioner.
